contea di ritrovamento: Lincolnshire (Inghilterra e Galles)

CORONER'S REPORT. Description of object. Incomplete silver finger ring, Henig type VIII. The ring has a circular bezel and triangular shoulders. The main part of the hoop is missing. Each shoulder is decorated with a hatched perimeter, with a rectangular collar going across it at near the top, thus forming a 'triangle' of hatching.
